newsitem.title: USA: GE unit FGIC to end quarterly earning report.
newsitem.headline: GE unit FGIC to end quarterly earning report.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co., a unit of General Electric Co.'s GE Capital Services, said Friday it will no longer publicly release a quarterly earnings report.

FGIC will continue to provide the information to regulators, rating agencies, and investors, but will not issue a public statement or press release, a spokesman for the bond insurance company, Tito Davilla, said in an interview.
Davilla said FGIC had been the only exception among GE Capital's 26 subsidiaries that released quarterly financials in a separate statement.

"This is a policy that's been in place for a long time and we've been the only exception to their consolidated reporting structure," Davilla said. GE Capital's financial statements will not break out FGIC's data separately, he said.
